title: STARTEX: Core Network Failure — EHR and Clinical Systems Unreachable

fields.location: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center, Toledo, Lucas County, Ohio
fields.load: High: ED holding 31 patients, both ICUs at capacity, two operating rooms in use
fields.staffing: Full staffing across clinical, IT, and facilities; on-call teams alerted
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 16:45 on Friday, March 13, 2026, at Ottawa River Regional Medical Center. At 16:38, the core network switch in room A-B02 failed. Failover to the secondary core in room C-212 did not occur. The EHR, laboratory information system, PACS, and secure messaging are currently unreachable from most clinical networks. Telephones remain functional. The IT on-call and Nursing Supervisor declared a system downtime at 16:41. The ED holds 31 patients, both ICUs are full, and OR 1 and OR 2 each have a case in progress. The vendor estimates four hours for a replacement. Nothing yet suggests anything other than a hardware failure.

status.name: Core Network
status.note: Primary core (A-B02) failed; failover to C-212 failed

status.name: EHR (CareLine)
status.note: Unreachable; no access to orders, charting, eMAR, results

status.name: Secure Messaging
status.note: Staff phones and nurse call system partially functional via phone

status.name: ED
status.note: 31 patients; awaiting triage and bed assignment

status.name: ICUs
status.note: Both ICUs at capacity; no new admissions allowed

fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm all roles have the ICS 201, EHR Downtime Procedures Annex (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026), and Cyber Incident Response Plan (ORRMC-CIRP-2026) in hand before starting.
fields.scenarioTitle: Core Collapse — Mass Casualty Surge During a Network Outage

instructorNote: Players must recognize the EHR and clinical systems are down, but no threat is yet identified. The initial response is to assess impact and activate HICS per Level 2.
